content.name: Grenade
entriesTemplate: As an action, a character can throw a grenade at a point up to 60 feet away. With a grenade launcher, the character can propel the grenade up to 120 feet away.

content.name: Grenade
entriesTemplate: As an action, you can either throw a grenade at a point up to 60 feet away or use a Grenade Launcher to propel the grenade to a point up to 1,000 feet away. The grenade explodes at that point, creating a particular effect in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Sphere}.
